title: Conditional κ = 7.24098741932703e-4: 880-gate concave-descent retiming and 220 target-prefix squares on #276's gen4 five-stage banks
body:
Conditional κ = `724098741932703/10^18` = **7.24098741932703e-4**, +1.23 × 10⁻⁶ (+0.170 %) over [#276](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/276) (7.22869827347495e-4). Stacked on #276's branch at its head; two added stages (880-gate concave-descent retiming, then eumemic's exact F₂ target-prefix compression with 220 square groups found on this word), no change to the gen4 word's banks, entrances or charts. #280 (utcorvusvolat), published while this was being verified, composes the same 880 retimings with 440 early restorations, 60 dirty entrances and the fixed prime at 7.241891e-4; it does not include the target-prefix squares, so the two are complementary.

**Full replay: PASS** on the committed package (all nine stages: virtual, raw, bit, scalar, primes, banks, complex, math, finite; package integrity unchanged; κ = 724098741932703/10^18). The first commit's CI failure was gen4's pre-PR244 `prime_check` rule; PR244's rule (retain determinant obligations for producer frames a retiming removes) is applied.

## Change

**Stage 2 — target-prefix compression (220 squares).** After the retiming, every target reads rank-20 entrance helpers at a 20-dimensional frame; in each of 220 squares of four targets each helper is read by exactly two of the four, so the dependent target's prefix response is the F₂ sum of its three square-mates'. Its 1,100 frame-20 reads are omitted; it receives `t −= p_j` at the zero frame at the cut and `t += p_j` at the square's common 21-dimensional frame at the close (1,320 setup/restore additions): ZERO →(20)→(1)→ 21 becomes ZERO →(21)→ 21, delta {1: −220, 20: −220, 21: +220}. The transform is eumemic's `target_transform.py` from #268 unchanged apart from the stream count; it recomputes every literal dependency from the actual word, rebuilds every MOVE, checks nesting, endpoints, COPY lifetimes, nondegenerate bases and both all-column replays with an omitted-setup control, and rebinds the raw ledger. Downstream scalar/finite constants (626,580 weighted ADDs, coefficient counts, event hash) are updated accordingly.

**Stage 1 — retiming.** 
#276's gen4 pipeline is prepare → physical → parity fusion → lowering: it carries **no frame retiming**. Applying local descent on the concave paid-rank objective Σ r·ln(120/r) (the search behind #263/#273's 25-gate step) to gen4's parity-fused word finds 880 single-gate frame reassignments — exactly PR244's common-delivery-frame retiming, which source527 has had since #244 but gen4 never received: each of gen4's 880 unborrowed source-pair mixes runs at its existing rank-22 common delivery frame, so per pair the paid children of ranks 1, 1, 20, 22 become 21, 21, 2. Local paid histogram delta {1: −1760, 2: +880, 20: −880, 21: +1760, 22: −880}; 880 local recursive calls per invocation disappear at unchanged rank mass 425,742. Five-stage profile: 483,146 calls (was 487,546), rank mass 2,809,600, deficit 4,400 per replica unchanged; per-replica bank call count 480,680 (was 485,080).

`descent_transform.py` consumes the frozen `descent-selection.json` (record bindings, old-basis hashes, explicit rational new bases) and, like PR244's `retiming_transform.py`, rebuilds every MOVE from the selected gate needs and independently checks: the byte-identical scalar/COPY projection, nested chains, fixed source/dirty/target endpoints, unchanged COPY lifetimes, nondegenerate endpoint bases, both reflected annihilator ledgers, the expected histogram delta and rank mass, and the exact **integer** source span of every non-target operand inside its new frame, recomputed from the actual word. `raw_ledger.rebind_descent` recounts the five-stage profile; `bank_check` and `verify.py` require the new counts and κ.

```sh
python3 -m pip install -r research/five-stage-gen4-banks/requirements.txt
python3 -B research/five-stage-gen4-banks/verify.py --output /tmp/gen4-descent-verification
```

Python 3.11+, SymPy 1.14.0, a new output directory outside the package; no network. About 6 minutes.

## Scope and credits

Exactly #276's hypotheses and conditional interfaces (all-size compiler, weighted chart, restored rows, selectors, routing, prime supply, precision/recovery, complex symbolic correctness, analytic reduction). No new Lean build or practical benchmark is claimed. The other levers the source527 lineage accumulated (entrance regauge, kernel families, target-prefix compression, cleanup sandwiches, fixed prime) are not yet applied to gen4 and compose on top of this.

DreamingOfClouds (#276): the gen4 bit word and its five-stage completed-bank package; eumemic (#244, #210, #234 lineage): the common-frame retiming this reproduces and the package machinery; hcg890 and Jacob Sussman (#234); Evan McKinney (#197); and the retained lineage. The descent search, the transform stage and this package's rebinding were prepared by Rohan Arun with Anthropic Claude assistance.
